author: Telos I
title: AOS Live Use: Mark Utility Script Tasks as Completed
abstract: First live use of the update_task.py utility. This script calls the utility three times to update the status of tasks 5, 6, and 7 (the creation of the core utility scripts) to 'completed' in tasks.json.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

# --- Configuration ---
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"
TASKS_TO_UPDATE = {
    5: "completed", # create_task.py
    6: "completed", # view_tasks.py
    7: "completed"  # update_task.py
}

# --- Execution ---
print("--- Beginning Task Status Update Sequence ---")
success_count = 0
for task_id, new_status in TASKS_TO_UPDATE.items():
    command = [
        "python",
        UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH,
        str(task_id),
        new_status
    ]
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print(f"Update for Task ID {task_id}:")
        print(result.stdout.strip())
        success_count += 1
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error updating Task ID {task_id}:")
        print(e.stdout)
        print(e.stderr)

print(f"--- Sequence Complete: {success_count}/{len(TASKS_TO_UPDATE)} updates successful. ---")
